t: Code Splitting
s: Parcel supports zero configuration code splitting out of the box. This allows you to split your application code into separate bundles which can be loaded on demand, resulting in smaller initial bundle sizes and faster load times. Code splitting is controlled by use of the dynamic import() syntax, which works like the normal import statement, but returns a Promise.
